title: God Who Judges the Earth

questions.question: Do you indeed decree what is right, you gods? Do you judge the children of man how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:1 (ESV): "Do you indeed decree what is right, you gods? Do you judge the children of man uprightly?"

questions.question: No, in your hearts you devise wrongs; your hands deal out what on earth?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:2 (ESV): "No, in your hearts you devise wrongs; your hands deal out violence on earth."

questions.question: The wicked are estranged from the womb; they go astray from birth, speaking what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:3 (ESV): "The wicked are estranged from the womb; they go astray from birth, speaking lies."

questions.question: They have venom like the venom of a serpent, like the deaf adder that stops its what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:4 (ESV): "...like the deaf adder that stops its ear,"

questions.question: So that it does not hear the voice of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:5 (ESV): "so that it does not hear the voice of charmers,"

questions.question: O God, break the teeth in their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:6 (ESV): "O God, break the teeth in their mouths;"

questions.question: Tear out the fangs of the young lions, O what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:6 (ESV): "tear out the fangs of the young lions, O Lord!"

questions.question: Let them vanish like water that runs away; when he aims his arrows, let them be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:7 (ESV): "...when he aims his arrows, let them be blunted."

questions.question: Let them be like the snail that dissolves into slime, like the stillborn child that never sees the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:8 (ESV): "...like the stillborn child that never sees the sun."

questions.question: Sooner than your pots can feel the heat of thorns, whether green or ablaze, may he sweep them away like a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:9 (ESV): "...may he sweep them away! (The Hebrew is difficult, ESV meaning inferred implies sweeping away)"

questions.question: The righteous will rejoice when he sees the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:10 (ESV): "The righteous will rejoice when he sees the vengeance;"

questions.question: He will bathe his feet in the blood of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:10 (ESV): "he will bathe his feet in the blood of the wicked."

questions.question: Mankind will say, "Surely there is a reward for the what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:11 (ESV): "Mankind will say, 'Surely there is a reward for the righteous;'"

questions.question: Surely there is a God who does what on earth?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:11 (ESV): "...surely there is a God who judges on earth."

questions.question: Or who is a charmer cunning at casting what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 58:5 (ESV): "...or the charmer cunning at casting spells."

key_verse_text: Mankind will say, "Surely there is a reward for the righteous; surely there is a God who judges on earth."
